title: Registry Compliance Note on Series Positions of Plan-Billed Outside Dose Entries
content:
# Registry compliance note — plan-billed outside dose entries and series positions

**Immunization Services.** A dose entry on an earlier vaccination course that was recorded from another provider (it names no Kestrel store) and is billed to a pharmacy benefit is a plan-billed outside entry. The positions in the series such entries hold bear on the dose number a screening and consent form covers on a series that continues that earlier course.

## The rule

Entries recorded from another provider and billed to a pharmacy benefit hold positions as follows.

- **(i) Kestrel reported a dose of the earlier course.** Where Kestrel reported a dose of the earlier course to the state registry — its history shows at least one registry report — the plan-billed outside entries are registry copies and each holds **0** positions.
- **(ii) Kestrel reported no dose, and a documented cash-paid outside entry exists.** Where the earlier course's history shows no registry report and it holds at least one cash-paid entry recorded from another provider that carries a lot number, the plan-billed outside entries together hold **1** position: one position between them however many there are, and none when there are none.
- **(iii) Kestrel reported no dose, and no documented outside entry exists.** Each plan-billed outside entry holds one position.

## Condition matrix

| Registry report on the earlier course | Documented cash-paid outside entry on it | Positions held by the plan-billed outside entries |
|---|---|---|
| At least one | Yes | 0 each |
| At least one | No | 0 each |
| None | Yes | 1 between them (0 when there are none) |
| None | No | 1 each |

The registry reports are read first: once Kestrel has reported a dose of the earlier course, the documented outside entries make no difference.

## Hypothetical illustrations

*Figures are hypothetical.*

- An earlier course shows one registry report and two plan-billed outside entries. The two entries hold 0 positions in all.
- An earlier course shows no registry report, one documented cash-paid outside entry and three plan-billed outside entries. The three entries hold 1 position between them.
- An earlier course shows no registry report, no documented outside entry and two plan-billed outside entries. They hold 2 positions, one each.
- An earlier course shows no registry report, a documented cash-paid outside entry and no plan-billed outside entry. No position is held on this account.
